description: T-I5b-1 (F1) instanced foliage scatter set. Game content: the engine knows only the schema (archetype card size, tint, sway flag, density weight). Per-instance PLACEMENT is a deterministic pure hash of (chunk coords, biome id, slope, moisture, instance index); the per-column DENSITY comes from the biome table's vegetation block (data/common/biomes.json), modulated render-side by slope/moisture. RENDER-ONLY: nothing here feeds the sim or world_hash. The sway flag is per-archetype: grass/canopy wave with the A2 wind field; pebbles/clutter do not. T-I5b-DR-foliage-blocker: colours DESATURATED toward natural olive/khaki (green no longer overpowers red/blue by the speckle-detector margin) with DARKER, lower-value bases, and the card SIZES shrunk so a dense scatter of small crossed blades reads as continuous ground cover rather than a few big flat neon decals. The frag stage adds a per-instance hue/value gradient (darker root, slightly lighter tip) so the field is not a flat single hue.
